title: Liria 10 – The Future Belongs to Them
summary: Morning began in a gentle golden light.
story:
Morning began in a gentle golden light.

Liria stood on an old stone bridge, watching the city awaken.

Below her, the river flowed calmly between the houses.

Merchants opened their shops along the streets. Craftspeople carried materials to their workshops. Children ran past their parents, laughing.

A young woman pushed a cart full of flowers across the bridge.

An old man carried a basket of fresh bread.

And somewhere in the distance, a musician began to play.

Liria smiled.

She remembered the earliest days of Novaris.

Back then, so much had existed only as an idea.

Plans, possibilities, and hopes.

Today, those dreams had become a living world.

A world full of people with their own dreams, worries, and choices.

"Excuse me!"

A little boy stopped beside her.

"Do you know how to get to the big marketplace?"

Liria bent down slightly toward him.

"Of course! Cross the bridge, then just follow the flower stalls."

"Thank you!"

The boy was about to run off when he turned around once more.

"Do you live here too?"

Liria looked out over the city.

For a brief moment, she considered the question.

Then she smiled.

"Yes. I think I do."

The boy waved and disappeared among the passersby.

Liria remained where she was for another moment.

She had helped found this world.

But its future had long since passed beyond the hands of its creators alone.

It belonged to the people who lived in it every day.

Liria closed her eyes and enjoyed the warmth of the morning sun.

Then she set off toward the marketplace.

Perhaps she would discover something new again today.

For even the founder of a world could never know what stories the next morning might hold.
